items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: James P. Johnson had the band.

ctx.x: I think it's good. What kind of a show was this show that you went to Europe with? What was it called again?

Plantation Days. Yeah. You know who launched Deez in New York? No. Barbara Deez? No. Well, he produced it. And, no, I beg your pardon, Leonard Harper. You remember Leonard Harper, don't you? No. That's right, I forget. That's New York. I bet your brother knew. He produced the shows. James P. Johnson had the band.
He was the leader of the band?

items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Well, it was Charles Elgar's band... And James P. took hold of the band... we went to Tom Schmauer's Green Mill Gardens with the show... James P., a lot of his music we were using.

ctx.x: He was the leader of the band?

Well, it was Charles Elgar's band. Elgar couldn't leave, you know, because he had too much. He had studio and different things there in Chicago. And James P. took hold of the band. He came. The whole band?
